channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Iran ceasefire holding for now, Hegseth says, after Iran attacks UAE, ships in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran's ceasefire appears to be holding after recent attacks on the UAE and ships in the Strait of Hormuz. US commentator Hegseth reported the situation as stable. The attacks had raised concerns about escalating tensions in the region.

item.title: Offensive stage of Iran war is over, US Secretary of State Rubio says
item.description: US Secretary of State Rubio stated that the offensive stage of the Iran war is over. An Iranian official responded, saying "We are just getting started," amid ongoing incidents in the Strait of Hormuz testing the ceasefire.

item.title: Rubio insists that the ceasefire is holding after Iran strikes UAE and commercial vehicles
item.description: US Secretary of State Rubio insisted that the ceasefire with Iran is holding after Iranian strikes on the UAE and commercial vehicles. The situation remains fragile following recent escalations in the region.

item.title: U.S. mission to reopen Strait of Hormuz will be temporary, Hegseth says
item.description: The US mission to reopen the Strait of Hormuz will be temporary. U. S. mission to reopen Strait of Hormuz will be temporary, Hegseth says The Washington Post. U. S.

item.title: Could an energy crisis get Philippines and China to cooperate in South China Sea?
item.description: The Philippines is seeking cooperation with China to secure oil supplies amid the Strait of Hormuz closure. The move comes as the country faces an energy crisis and strained relations with potential suppliers.

item.title: Cruise Ship Struck by Hantavirus Is to Head to Canary Islands, W.H.O. Says
item.description: A cruise ship with a hantavirus outbreak is headed to the Canary Islands, where it will be received by the Spanish government. The World Health Organization reported possible human-to-human transmission played a role in the outbreak on board.

item.title: Australia's DigiCo Infrastructure REIT to sell Chicago data centre for $750 million
item.description: DigiCo Infrastructure REIT agreed to sell its Chicago data centre to an unnamed buyer for $750 million. The sale is part of DigiCo's strategy to divest certain assets. The deal is expected to close by the end of the year.

item.title: Offensive stage of Iran war is "over", says Rubio
item.description: US Senator Marco Rubio stated that the offensive stage of the Iran war is over. He added that US forces would respond if attacked. Rubio's comments came after recent military actions between the US and Iran.

item.title: Rubio says Iran combat operation launched in February is ‘over,’ as tensions around strait remain
item.description: US Senator Marco Rubio stated that Iran's combat operation launched in February is over. Tensions remain high around the Strait of Hormuz. The situation has been closely watched by international observers.

item.title: Trump Looks for a Silver Bullet to End the Iran War. There May Be None.
item.description: US President Donald Trump is trying to increase economic pressure on Iran, but Tehran is unlikely to make a deal without a significant compromise. Iran's government has shown no signs of backing down from its nuclear program.

item.title: Putin accused of ‘utter cynicism’ for attacks amid ceasefire talks
item.description: Ukraine accused Putin of cynicism for attacks during ceasefire talks. Ukraine war live: Putin accused of ‘utter cynicism’ for attacks amid ceasefire talks The Independent.

item.title: Spain to receive hantavirus-hit ship in Canary Islands
item.description: The MV Hondius, a cruise ship hit by a hantavirus outbreak, will dock in the Canary Islands, Spain. Three passengers on board have died from the virus since it was detected off Cape Verde. The ship had been stuck offshore since the outbreak was identified.

item.title: Arsenal beat Atletico to reach first Champions League final in 20 years
item.description: Arsenal won 1-0 against Atletico, securing a 2-1 aggregate victory in their Champions League semifinal. Bukayo Saka scored the decisive goal, propelling Arsenal to their first Champions League final in 20 years. The win marks a significant milestone for the team.

item.title: Before Vatican trip, Rubio defends Trump remarks on Pope Leo over Iran
item.description: US Senator Marco Rubio defended Trump's remarks on Pope Leo XIII's views on Iran before meeting Pope Francis at the Vatican. Rubio's comments come amid strained relations between the US and Iran.

item.title: Israel kills one boy, injures officers in strike on Gaza police station
item.description: Israel struck a Gaza police station, killing 15-year-old Mahmoud Sahweil and injuring officers. The incident occurred in a volatile region with ongoing tensions. A 15-year-old boy, Mahmoud Sahweil, was killed when Israel struck a Gaza police station.

item.title: U.S. says it's made Hormuz safe for commercial shipping, but standoff hasn't changed
item.description: The US announced a new military strategy to secure the Strait of Hormuz for commercial shipping. The administration has announced a new military strategy designed to open up the Strait of Hormuz to commercial shipping, but it's unclear if this will break Iran's grip on the key waterway.

item.title: US Army says ‘Project Freedom’ in blockaded Hormuz has ‘just begun’
item.description: The US Army's 'Project Freedom' to secure safe passage of ships in the blocked Strait of Hormuz has begun. A US Central Command spokesperson confirmed the mission's start. A US Central Command spokesperson says the mission to secure a safe passage of ships in the blocked waterway has begun.

item.title: US says Iran has not broken ceasefire following clashes over strait
item.description: The US said Iran has not broken the ceasefire following clashes over the strait. The development comes amid heightened tensions in the Middle East. Middle East war: US says Iran has not broken ceasefire following clashes over strait Financial Times.

item.title: In Venezuela, Trump Vowed to Show Accountability. But Secret Oil Deals Linger.
item.description: Trump officials made secret oil deals in Venezuela despite vows of accountability. Trump officials and their Venezuelan allies have promised a new era of accountability to unlock Venezuela’s immense oil wealth.

item.description: Seton Hall graduate leads tech policy and global AI initiatives in Malaysia. Diplomacy Grad Leads Tech Policy and Global AI Initiatives in Malaysia Seton Hall.
